Representative calculations plus exhaustive cheap recipe-contract coverage.

reader, median, ROI and diagnostic adapters. All such recipes are still built,
admitted and compared to their frozen selected specification. Calculations are
performed for every distinct operation/port domain and input family instead.

the identical five-template catalogue is shared. Catalogue/configuration and
loaded-code mutation witnesses deliberately do not use this fixture.
Share immutable code objects while retaining real source/binding admission.
Distinguish numerical fixture definitions from reorganized test methods.

Functional units with independently owned scenario fixtures.

Scenario assertions still run as subtests, without creating nested unittest
runs or reporting old method executions as new discovered tests. Mutable
windows, directories, tensors and cleanup stacks remain scenario-local.

Observe selected Python boundaries without profiling unrelated calculations.

The callbacks retain the existing ``(frame, event, arg)`` convention. Python
3.12's local monitoring events leave the actual functions, aliases and code
identities intact, unlike wrapping the functions with mocks.
Isolated full-suite workers with exhaustive assignment and fail-closed results.

Read-only test prerequisite checks and optional local fixture provisioning.

Expected bytes are declared in config/test_fixtures.json. Tests never generate
or download baselines. An external fixture directory uses repository-relative
paths, including artifacts/; only missing hash-verified files are copied.

Reuse reference dependency imports in healthy functional calculation tests.

audited PlantCV imports, calculations and response validation execute each time.
Tests of interpreter startup, transport, isolation or source loading retain the
production one-shot launcher. The fixture changes no application code.

Test-only stdio worker: fresh PlantCV imports, shared third-party imports.

here executes that same worker's main and all its original verification.

mutation callbacks. No mutable archive or numerical result is cached globally.
Explicit review declarations for synthetic complete-outline test fixtures.

CPU/Qt is an allowlist, not an inference from skip decorators. CUDA contains
